project.name: Vidulum CashFlow Group
project.description:
Everything about a person's money moving in and out: the cash flow itself, what a bank statement becomes on the way in, and which accounts the owner admits to.
An aggregator, not a parent - every module below still inherits from the root pom, so moving a module in or out of this folder changes no dependency and no artifactId. Same arrangement as market/ and wealth/. Build the group with `./mvnw test -f vidulum-app-cashflow/pom.xml`; that reactor does not contain vidulum-shared-kernel, so it resolves it from the local repository.
It used to be a jar holding five subdomains, and this folder is what is left after they became artifacts of their own - steps 23 to 26 in docs/features-backlog/2026-10-16-cashflow-module-boundaries.md. The order below is the dependency order: contracts, then the aggregate, then the three modules that consume it.
Two rules hold inside this group, and both are checked rather than hoped for: - vidulum-cashflow is depended on by nobody here. bank-data-ingestion, bank-data-adapter, user-financial-profile and recurring-rules compile against cashflow-api and user-financial-profile-api, never against the implementation. That is what lets vidulum-cashflow-tests hold everyone's integration tests without a cycle. - No module here has a test-scope dependency on another. The tests that need a running system live outside the group, in vidulum-cashflow-tests.
